name: Keyboard Layout Switcher
author: jesusarchive
description: Pick keyboard layouts from the Omarchy bar, with optional shortcuts and a clickable keyboard viewer.

barWidget.description: Shows the active keyboard layout. Click to choose another.

schema.label: Bar Appearance
schema.description: Show the layout icon, an outlined code, or plain text while the menu is closed.

schema.label: Show Input Source Name in Bar
schema.description: Show the full input source name beside the layout or keyboard icon.

schema.label: Show Emojis in Menu
schema.description: Open Omarchy's built-in Emojis picker from the layout menu.

schema.label: Show Keyboard Viewer in Menu
schema.description: Show a menu item that opens the clickable keyboard viewer.

schema.label: Show Input Source Name in Menu
Keyboard Viewer Shape (Advanced)
